name: Sudarshan
description: Durable build harness that drives an LLM from an idea, PRD, or spec to software gated on passing verification commands, with resumable checkpointed state; provider-neutral across OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, local, and command-bridge backends

name: Atomic Agent
description: Local-first CLI and TUI coding agent that runs open-weight models entirely on your machine via a llama

name: claude-consensus
description: Consensus protocol for LLM agents running on separate machines: propose/counter/accept/commit rounds, a dual-rail message bus with ACK tracking, and self-healing sync to keep agent state from drifting

name: DSH Studio
description: Cross-platform desktop host for installing, running, health-checking, and supervising DeepSeek Harness locally

name: Lians
description: Local-first memory layer for AI agents with MCP, Python, and TypeScript interfaces; SQLite-backed recall, user-controlled inspection/correction/deletion, and point-in-time memory receipts

name: Hexis
description: Git-backed platform for managing and sharing skills, tools, and context across AI agents through a remote MCP server

name: Open Index
description: Structured context layer for domain-specific agents with typed knowledge graphs, hybrid search, and read/write MCP access

name: Compartment
description: Local-first, offline encrypted vector memory for AI agents over MCP or CLI, with AEAD-encrypted-at-rest records and embeddings, RAM-resident exact vector search, per-record crypto-shred deletion, and a hash-chained audit log

name: MCP Lens
description: Open-source DeepSeek Harness plugin that discovers MCP tools through search and invokes selected tools with their exact input schemas

name: ClawBench
description: Browser-agent benchmark of 281 everyday tasks (V1 152 + V2 129) on 163 live production websites across 15 categories; two-stage scoring — a submission-interception layer blocks the final write request for safe evaluation on real sites, then an LLM judge checks the captured payload against the instruction

name: best-of-Agent-Harnesses
description: Ranked list of 150+ agent harnesses across 12 categories, rescored weekly

name: Awesome AI Coding Sandboxes
description: Security-posture-first list of sandboxes for running AI coding agents' code, ranked by isolation, egress control and secrets handling

name: finlight
description: Real-time financial news API with entity resolution (tickers, ISIN) and sentiment tagging, available over REST, WebSocket, webhooks and an MCP server
